decisions.reason: The modular plant concept already shows a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, which resolves much of its uncertainty in its favor and justifies keeping the option open and building on it.
The mobile slow-speed shredder belongs to the firm's core line and has a dedicated page, so it costs little to keep and fits established demand, making abandonment after only one year unjustified.

This second modular plant concept is only mentioned and has no reported results, so its prospects remain uncertain; keeping it costs little, but it partly overlaps with Product A and could be consolidated later.
The mobile trommel screen complements the firm's mobile processing portfolio at low incremental cost, and one year gives too little evidence to justify giving up the option.
